title: Electrospun PAN + CALF-20 fibers: characterization and removal of Pb(II) and Cu(II) ions from aqueous solution
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,7189-7203

Guilherme H. F. Melo, Yuxin Liu, Jinfeng Zhang, Nicholas Fylstra, George K. H. Shimizu, Uttandaraman Sundararaj
For the first time, electrospun fibers of CALF-20 + PAN were produced for very efficient removal of Pb(II) and Cu(II) from aqueous solutions.
